title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten verified free activities at California Lutheran University and nearby public community spaces, with no admission or purchase required.

cards.title: Browse the Rolland Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Free exhibitions inside William Rolland Stadium
cards.notes: Enter through the stadium rotunda, browse the current exhibition, and check the exhibition schedule before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery outing on the Cal Lutheran campus with complimentary public parking nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran states that Rolland Art Gallery admission and parking in designated G lots are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify that an exhibition is installed before visiting.

cards.title: See Student Art at Rolland Art Center
cards.subtitle: A free weekday gallery stop on Campus Drive
cards.notes: Walk through the student exhibition space on a weekday, then compare what you saw with the nearby campus gallery program.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost look at student artwork in a named visual-art space on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies William Rolland Art Center as a student exhibition space and states that gallery admission and designated public parking are free.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; exhibitions may close temporarily during installation.

cards.title: Watch Zootopia 2 Under the Stars
cards.subtitle: A free outdoor movie beside Cal Lutheran
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or lawn chair to Thousand Oaks Community Park and arrive early for the family-friendly activities before sundown.
cards.short_summary: A free, all-ages outdoor film night immediately north of the university area.
cards.evidence_claim: Conejo Recreation & Park District advertises a free showing of Zootopia 2 with free activities beginning one hour before the movie.
cards.access_notes: Friday, August 14, 2026; activities begin at 6 p.m. and the movie starts at sundown.

cards.entity_name: The Mother Road at 100 Years Old: Voices of Route 66
cards.title: Hear Stories from Route 66
cards.subtitle: A free history talk at Grant R. Brimhall Library
cards.notes: Meet friends in the community room for Anthony Arno’s presentation, then trade favorite Route 66 stories afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free evening program centered on the history and cultural memory of Route 66.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Thousand Oaks lists this library presentation for August 13 and states that all library programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Thursday, August 13, 2026, 6–7:30 p.m. in the Grant R. Brimhall Library Community Room.

cards.title: Crochet and Catch Up
cards.subtitle: A free social craft session for ages 11 and up
cards.notes: Bring your crochet supplies, claim a seat in the community room, and work alongside beginners and experienced makers.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed, no-admission afternoon for crocheting and conversation at the public library.
cards.evidence_claim: The city lists the August crochet club for ages 11+ and states that all Thousand Oaks Library programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Friday, August 14, 2026, 2:30–4 p.m. in the Grant R. Brimhall Library Community Room; bring your own supplies.

cards.title: Try the Maker Machines
cards.subtitle: Free hands-on making in the library Teen Space
cards.notes: Choose the button maker, Meta Quest 3 headset, or 3D printer and compare projects with friends during the drop-in session.
cards.short_summary: A free technology-and-crafts meetup featuring three named maker tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Thousand Oaks lists Maker Monday with a button maker, Meta Quest 3 and 3D printer, and states that all library programs are free.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Monday, August 17, 2026, 4:30–6 p.m. in the Grant R. Brimhall Library Teen Space; for ages 11+.

cards.title: Make a Nature Journal Page
cards.subtitle: A free summer journaling activity for ages 11–18
cards.notes: Pick up the library guide, sketch or write outdoors with friends, and return one finished page by the submission deadline.
cards.short_summary: A free guided nature-journaling project with materials available from the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The city invites ages 11–18 to collect a Nature Journaling guide and submit a page, while stating that all listed library programs are free.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Open through Saturday, August 15, 2026; participation is limited to ages 11–18.

cards.title: Weave a Custom Bookmark
cards.subtitle: A free teen craft hour at Grant R. Brimhall Library
cards.notes: Join the library’s guided session, weave a bookmark design, and swap color or pattern ideas with other participants.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, hands-on weaving activity designed for tweens and teens.
cards.evidence_claim: The city lists a custom loom-bookmark activity for ages 11–18 and states that all Thousand Oaks Library programs are free.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Wednesday, August 26, 2026, 4–5 p.m. in the Grant R. Brimhall Library Teen Space; for ages 11–18.

cards.title: Listen or Read at Open Mic Poetry
cards.subtitle: A free community poetry night at the library
cards.notes: Bring a poem to share or simply listen as local writers take the mic in partnership with the Ventura County Poetry Project.
cards.short_summary: A recurring free gathering where community members can hear and share poetry.
cards.evidence_claim: The city lists Open Mic Poetry on the second and fourth Wednesdays and states that all library programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Wednesday, August 26, 2026, 6–7:30 p.m. in the Grant R. Brimhall Library Community Room.

cards.title: Practice English in Conversation
cards.subtitle: A free, informal language meetup open to learners
cards.notes: Drop into the training room, practice spoken English with other learners, and bring a topic that can start a group conversation.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming, no-cost conversation session for non-native English speakers.
cards.evidence_claim: The city describes the ESL Conversation Group as open to all non-native speakers and states that all library programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: August Events at the Thousand Oaks Library
cards.access_notes: Thursday, August 13, 2026, 6–7 p.m. in the Grant R. Brimhall Library Technology Training Room; registration recommended, walk-ins welcome.
